(1) Mr. Piyush Garg, learned counsel for the appellant.
(2) Mr. Rakesh Kumar Joshi, learned Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.

(3) This appeal has been preferred against the judgment & order dated 31.07.2023 passed by learned Special Judge (POCSO)/Additional District & Sessions Judge, District Dehradun in Special Sessions Trial No. 85 of 2021, whereby appellant has been convicted under Sections 363 & 376 of I.P.C. and Section 5/6 of Protection of Children From Sexual Offence (POCSO) Act.

sentences.text:
He has been directed to undergo imprisonment for three years under Section 363 of I.P.C. with fine of 20,000/-
and, in default of payment of fine, he was sentenced to undergo further one month simple imprisonment; he has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for twenty years under Section 5/6 of POCSO Act with fine of 10,000/- and, in default of payment of fine, he was sentenced to undergo further one month simple imprisonment.
It was directed that all the sentences shall run concurrently.
(4) As per Office report, there is delay of five days in filing the appeal.
(5) Learned State Counsel submits that he has no objection if the delay in filing the appeal is condoned.
(6) Accordingly, delay condonation application (IA No. 2 of 2004) is allowed.

(8) Admit.
(9) Summon the lower court record.
